gags.name: only his eyes in the dark
presses her button in her own light
frowns at the dial, then at us
the whole flight in one stride
shows the stairs like a gym
reads in bed in the hall
presses the button at the foot of the stairs
gone: a hole of speed, the briefcase spinning
one second: dark, she stays lit
eyes left, right, left in the dark
presses the button above his head
looks up at the button, jaw drops
